يبتسرون (form VIII)
# يَبْتَسِرُونَ (yabtasirūna) /jab.ta.si.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
# يُبْتَسَرُونَ (yubtasarūna) /jub.ta.sa.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
